title: Beware of shipping charges!
text: Beware of shipping charges!. Somehow I missed that the shipping price on a $20 set of baking pans was $36, even though I live less than 35 miles away from the seller.  The pans are great.  I have had only good experiences with NordicWare.  Next time I'll buy directly from the maker.

product_metadata.title: Nordic Ware Natural Aluminum Commercial Baker's Half Sheet and Baker's Quarter Sheet
features: Baker's Half Sheet and Quarter Sheet natural aluminum commercial bakeware is made of pure aluminum which will never rust for a lifetime of durability
Baked goods rise and bake evenly due to aluminum's superior heat conductivity and the reinforced encapsulated steel rim prevents warping
Pan dimensions, Half Sheet exterior 17.88 x 12.88 x 1.06, interior 16.5 x 11.38 x 1 inches, Quarter Sheet exterior 12.875 x 9.5 x 1 inches, interior 12.25 x 8.875 x 0.9 inches
Easy clean up, hand wash only
Proudly made in the USA by Nordic Ware
description: This bakeware set includes two useful items to have in the kitchen. Baker's Half Sheet is a true kitchen must-have, this is our most popular Naturals piece. Baker's Quarter Sheet is great for brownies and small batches of cookies. Dishwasher use is not advised, as discoloration will occur due to the cleaning agents used in automatic dishwasher detergent
